card.name: First digit of a multi-digit number
card.fires_on: The first digit (often 1 or 2) of a number that continues into more digits, in tables, concentrations, coordinates or sizes. The next characters are usually more digits, a decimal point or a unit.

modes.label: Drug concentrations
modes.description: Leading digit of a percent strength or volume in injection preparation text.

modes.label: Coordinates and measurements
modes.description: Leading or middle digit in latitude, longitude, distance or gun-size figures.

card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number that is still being written out, such as 10% or 100 mL.
